title: Linear Matrix Predicates
objective: Implement source-transparent matrix predicates and support/nonpivot scans with identical ZZ QQ and GF(p) semantics

handoff.summary: Added 24 source-transparent typed-Python kernels for diagonal, symmetric, triangular, scalar, nilpotent, nonzero-position, and echelon-nonpivot queries over generated FmpzMatrix/FmpqMatrix resources and packed GF(p) buffers. Exhaustive differential coverage checks every binary matrix through 3x3 across native and fallback paths, while 1000x1000 performance gates cover sparse and dense scans.
risks: Public Matrix methods are intentionally not wired in this lane; the integration lane owns matrix.py and the shared Node test manifest.
Exact nonzero/nonpivot scans return capacity + 1 when an output buffer is too small, so public dispatch must validate the returned count before reading results.
Prime-field nilpotence is a post-charpoly coefficient scan; integration should call the existing declared dense-prime charpoly kernel first.
Public dispatch must preserve Sage's rectangular-matrix error semantics before invoking square-only predicates.
next_steps: Register test/linear-matrix-predicates.cjs in test/node-test-manifest.cjs from the integration lane.
Add a lazy sagejs.linear_algebra.matrix_predicates loader and Matrix methods for is_diagonal, is_symmetric, is_triangular, is_scalar, is_nilpotent, nonzero_positions, and nonpivots.

Dispatch ZZ and QQ to generated resource kernels, dispatch packed GF(p) to the split fixed-signature kernels, and allocate Int64Buffer outputs for exact resources versus UInt64Buffer outputs for prime fields.
For nonpivots, compute the echelon form before scanning; for GF(p) nilpotence, obtain the existing declared charpoly into n + 1 coefficients before calling characteristic_is_nilpotent.
